sections.Profile:
"Magic" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Playmatic in 1973. The game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, one slingshot, four standup targets, two hinged targets, and a kick-out hole.

- Manufacturer: Playmatic
- Years made: 1973
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Women, Magic, Original Theme, 1970s, Fantasy
